method: Identify baseline gaps, order by severity, then apply Six Thinking Hats to select bounded corrections; no simulated reviewer approvals.

severity_definitions.critical: Immediate demonstrated severe harm/data loss requiring stop; none established by this document review.
severity_definitions.high: Can mislead physical configuration, acquisition validity, evidence acceptance or capability claims; address before relying on the affected path.
severity_definitions.medium: Impairs source selection, reproducibility, provenance or review completeness.
severity_definitions.low: Maintenance/navigation efficiency with bounded current impact.
